Supernova mid-detonation, the shock wave punching through the progenitor's outer hydrogen envelope, a luminous blue-white ring expanding faster than ten thousand kilometers per second against the host galaxy's dim spiral arms.

Black hole tidal-disruption event mid-shred, the doomed G-type star stretched into a glowing orange-white debris stream curling inward, a hard X-ray flash blooming from the accretion disk's innermost stable orbit.

Gamma-ray burst pinpoint erupting at cosmological distance, a blinding white-blue needle of collimated electromagnetic energy punching through the frame, the host galaxy's disk barely visible beneath the transient's overwhelming afterglow.

Neutron star merger kilonova mid-ejection, a red-gold lanthanide-rich cocoon of freshly synthesized heavy elements expanding outward at one-fifth the speed of light, blue polar ejecta fan visible at higher latitudes.

Magnetar starquake X-ray flash mid-burst, a blinding hard-radiation pulse erupting from the neutron star's cracked crust, the surrounding nebula briefly illuminated in a ghostly blue-white resonance echo.

Active galactic nucleus jet ignition, a relativistic plasma column just launching from the central supermassive black hole, a brilliant knot of synchrotron blue light piercing megaparsecs of intergalactic medium ahead of it.
Solar coronal mass ejection mid-launch, a billion-ton magnetic plasma arch tearing free of the solar limb in extreme-ultraviolet gold and teal, a dark cavity forming behind the rising flux rope.

Pulsar wind nebula expanding outward, high-energy electron-positron pairs sweeping a torus of electric-blue synchrotron radiation into the surrounding supernova remnant, interior wisps shearing away from the central pulsar's equatorial wind.

Cosmic-ray air-shower cascade mid-development, a branching silver-blue particle tree descending through the upper atmosphere, Cherenkov light cone illuminating the mesosphere in a faint violet wash visible from low orbit.

Type Ia supernova nucleosynthesis flash at carbon-burning runaway ignition, the white dwarf's degenerate interior lighting up in a symmetrical orange-white fireball, no core remnant forming as the entire star disintegrates outward.

Cepheid variable at pulsation maximum, the supergiant's photosphere swollen to peak radius, a warm yellow-gold disk blazing several times brighter than its quiescent state, limb darkening softened by the outward-moving pressure wave.

Recurrent nova mid-outburst, a thermonuclear hydrogen detonation spreading across the white dwarf's accreted surface, a brilliant white shell of ejected gas expanding visibly in a single still frame at several hundred kilometers per second.

Brown dwarf failed-ignition flash, a brief orange-red deuterium-burning pulse illuminating the substellar object's cloudy photosphere, surrounding infrared emission tracing the turbulent convective envelope momentarily brightened beyond normal luminosity.

Protostar bipolar jet first-launch, two opposing columns of ionized hydrogen punching out of the circumstellar disk in electric blue, Herbig-Haro bow shocks already glowing where the jets meet the surrounding molecular cloud.

Gravitational wave chirp moment, two black holes completing their final inspiral orbit, no photon emission yet but the surrounding accretion disk rippling in a subtle Doppler-shifted ring as spacetime curvature peaks at merger.

Comet outburst from cryovolcanic vent eruption, a sudden brightness surge driven by subsurface CO2 venting, a fresh dust-and-gas fan spreading asymmetrically from the nucleus and curving anti-sunward in a distinct yellow-white secondary tail.

Microlensing magnification peak, a background K-dwarf temporarily amplified sixteenfold by a foreground compact object, the source star's Einstein-ring arc glowing in an unnaturally perfect blue-white circle against the dense galactic-bulge star field.

Hot Jupiter atmospheric escape stream mid-blowoff, UV-bright hydrogen and helium plasma streaming away from the irradiated exoplanet in a comet-like tail, the host star's extreme-UV radiation sculpting the escaping gas into a curved ion plume.

M-dwarf super-flare at apex, the red star's chromosphere erupting in a white-blue electromagnetic surge fifty times the star's quiescent luminosity, the surrounding planetary system briefly bathed in the hard UV and X-ray pulse.

Magnetized neutron star glitch event mid-spin-up, the pulsar's rotation suddenly jumping to higher frequency, a concentric X-ray pulse ring propagating outward through the wind nebula from the moment of crustal angular-momentum transfer.

Massive star core-collapse supernova shock breakout, the first photons escaping the progenitor's surface in an ultraviolet flash lasting minutes, the stellar surface brightening unevenly as the shock wave breaks through different latitude bands.

Hypernova mid-detonation, a Wolf-Rayet star's iron core collapsing while the outer layers detonate in a rotationally symmetric disk-like explosion ten times brighter than a standard supernova, twin polar jets of blue-white ejecta piercing the equatorial debris.

Quasar broad-line emission flare, the central accretion disk in a high state flooding the broad-line region with ionizing photons, a luminous turquoise-white continuum overwhelmingly outshining the elliptical host galaxy's entire stellar population.

Stellar occultation by a Kuiper Belt object, a distant star blinking out as the dark irregular silhouette transits across it, diffraction fringes ringing the occulted star in concentric arcs that trace the occulter's sharp icy limb.

Interstellar bow shock from a runaway O-star, the hypervelocity star's stellar wind plowing into the surrounding ISM at supersonic speed, a crescent-shaped infrared arc glowing in polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbon emission ahead of the speeding stellar photosphere.
